name: ROSMAR ALEJANDRA MENDOZA CANCHICA
title: Systems Engineer & Technical Project Manager | Agile & AI Delivery
professional_summary: Systems Engineer certified by the PMI in PMP® Fundamentals and CPMAI™, offering 7+ years of professional technology experience orchestrating critical software delivery across hyper-scale tech (MercadoLibre), fintech startups (Mo Technologies), and multinational banking (Scotiabank). Combines strong technical depth (distributed microservices, cloud APIs) with strategic project leadership: orchestrating Scrum/Kanban squads, governing 99%+ production availability SLAs, automating executive KPI dashboards in Power BI, and embedding generative AI frameworks to accelerate Time-to-Market and operational efficiency. Uniquely skilled at aligning business priorities with technical execution to drive predictable, high-impact releases.

work_experience.context_problem: High-volume distributed microservices platform requiring full-cycle ownership, cross-functional agile facilitation, and end-to-end API observability.
achievements: Agile Governance & SDLC Lifecycle: Led agile squad orchestration under Scrum/Kanban across high-throughput distributed microservices; optimized backlog grooming and team capacity, improving sprint delivery predictability by 20%.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment: Spearheaded alignment between regional engineering, product, and operations teams; managed inter-team dependencies and mitigated delivery risks to guarantee continuous, frictionless releases.

Business Continuity & High-Availability SLAs (99%+): Governed telemetry observability and incident triage protocols for mission-critical Golang services, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to safeguard 99%+ platform availability for millions of users.
AI-Driven Process Transformation (CPMAI™): Architected and deployed generative AI operational workflows (Cursor, Claude, CPMAI™), accelerating code refactoring and test automation turnaround by 30%.

work_experience.summary: Orchestrated end-to-end technical delivery and operational governance across a fast-scaling B2B fintech startup. Directed cross-functional alignment between engineering and product to deploy digital credit APIs and cloud integrations (Python/AWS) on schedule; restructured Level 2 incident response via Jira Service Desk, cutting MTTR by 25% and consistently sustaining 99%+ enterprise SLA compliance with international banking partners.
